locations.name: Valley of Elah
locations.note: battle site between two hillsides; brook with smooth stones

sections.title: The armies face off and Goliath defies Israel
Jesse sends David to the camp with provisions
David hears the challenge and questions the soldiers
David kills Goliath with sling and stone
Israel pursues; David brought before Saul

brief.era: Iron Age I, ancient Israel, c. 11th century BC.
brief.place: Valley of Elah: two opposing hillside camps with a dry brook valley between; olive scrub, terraced hills, tents, wagons, battle lines.
brief.dress: Israelite soldiers in simple tunics, leather and minimal armor; Saul and officers with sword and cloak. Goliath in full bronze: helmet, scale coat of mail, bronze shin guards, javelin, huge spear with weaver's-beam shaft, shield carried by an attendant. David as shepherd: tunic, shepherd's pouch/staff, sling, five smooth stones; briefly in Saul's oversized armor which he removes.
brief.buildings_and_objects: Tents, wagons, camp baggage, brook with smooth stones, sling, sword, severed head, cheeses and loaves of provisions.
depiction_rules: Goliath must appear towering, many heads taller than David
David is a ruddy, handsome youth, not armored in the fight
no sword in David's hand when the stone strikes; he takes Goliath's own sword for the beheading
Yahweh is never depicted as a figure; no divine form on stage
armies shown as massed ranks on opposing hillsides
